_schema: Q424 (gate loosened by Q449, D209) ADDITIVE companion to expected-differences-copyedit.json (protected): slug -> [SPEC clause id] for notes where copy-edit v2's title/summary/body differs from v1's golden (goldens/v1-copyedit) because a confirmed clause requires it. Read only by CopyEditV2HarnessTests.swift, merged with the Q423 file. Same stale rule: a slug listed here whose v2 record equals the golden fails. Side by side for Tuur: plan/reads/copyedit-v2.md.

_why.C30: each picture is its own paragraph after the same-index text paragraph; v1 placed it by 6-word anchors and left stray blank lines.
_why.C178: title and summary read prose with no [[ ]]: picture markers out, wikilinks to their shown text. New title calls, recorded once with -recordcopyeditv2. typed-user-wikilink: v1 sent [[Lotte Vos]] to the model and shipped '[[Lotte Vos]] Vos'.
_why.C177: a failed post-condition ships the words unedited: a proper noun the input never says (typed-title-derived: v1 shipped an invented essay on the Dutch language), a flipped language, or no words at all (whitespace / picture-only: v1 called the model on nothing and shipped an invented Dutch essay and title).
_why.C35: D209 (Q449): the edit ships when it drops ordinary words (okay, so, yeah, colour, whole phrases: those notes now equal v1 and left this file); the words ship unedited only when the edit loses a name or a number (edge-tag-case-dupes: "typed three times" lost its three) or translates (voice-mix-code-switch).
_why.C34: a typed note is never re-paragraphed: typed-headings-and-tags (the model merged 10 typed paragraphs into 5) and typed-wall-one-paragraph (the model split one typed paragraph) ship as typed.
